judgment_text:
ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed seeking a direction to the second respondent to accept the discontinuance of the petitioner from the course of B.A.M.S. and receive the discontinuation penalty of rupees one lakh as per the prospectus and agreement bond and forthwith issue the transfer certificate along with original certificate without any remarks as per the application for the transfer certificate dated 29-12-2025 and subsequent representations dated 18-2-2026 and 28-2-2026.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side. With the consent of both sides, the Writ Petition is taken up for hearing at the admission stage itself. Since no adverse order is to be passed as against the second respondent, notice to the second respondent is dispensed with.

3. It is the case of the petitioner that on allotment of seat by the first respondent in the second respondent college, she joined B.A.M.S. UG Course by submitting all necessary documents and paying prescribed first year fee and also executed an agreement bond as per Annexure III of the prospectus issued by the first respondent. As per the said bond, the penalty of Rs 1 Lakh has to be paid if the student discontinues the Course. Since the petitioner met with an accident and was not able to pursue the course further, she made a request to the second respondent for issuance of transfer certificate, for which, the second respondent demanded a sum of Rs 15 lakhs which is an exorbitant amount and refused to receive the penalty amount and also ill treated the petitioner and her parents. Due to which, the petitioner made several representations to the respondents as well as to various authorities, however, the same evoked no response and hence, the present Writ Petition.

4. In view of the limited prayer sought for by the petitioner in this Writ Petition, there shall be a direction to the second respondent to consider the representations of the petitioner dated 18-2-2026 and 28-2-2026 and to pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

5. With the above direction, the Writ Petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs.
